# Quality Engineering Orchestration Skill

Coordinate quality from requirements through release. Check requirement testability, risk-based strategy, test case coverage, test automation, environments/data, defect triage, regression, non-functional checks and release criteria. For each phase create a QE checklist and traceability evidence. Do not own the implementation or self-approve the phase. Gate status is PASS only when required evidence exists, no blocking defects remain and residual risks are explicitly accepted by the human owner.
